Presenting "Titli Full Song" video from Shah Rukh Khan most anticipated movie of 2013 "Chennai Express" directed by much talented Rohit Shetty. The music of this movie is by Vishal Shekhar while lyrics are penned by Amitabh Bhattacharya.
Song: TITLI
Singer: CHINMAYI SRIPAADA, GOPI SUNDER
Music: VISHAL-SHEKHAR
Lyrics: AMITABH BHATTACHARYA, TAMIL LYRICS : CHARULATHA MANI, MADHUMITHA MANI
Music on T-SERIES
